motifs.name: fall
motifs.note: down a sixth by thirds, a step back up, and the note it was looking for held; two notes to climb out on

motifs.name: fall_up
motifs.note: the same a third higher while the chords go down

motifs.name: crest
motifs.note: the top: the raised fourth of the flat-two chord, then the leading note held a whole bar

motifs.name: settle
motifs.note: the first cell again, turned to land on the ninth

motifs.name: tune
motifs.note: down a sixth by thirds, a step back up, and the note it was looking for held; two notes to climb out on

motifs.name: crest_wide
motifs.note: the top at half speed: the turn

motifs.name: head
motifs.note: the five notes everything else is made of

motifs.name: climb
motifs.note: the head four times, a step higher each time: the run

motifs.name: spike
motifs.note: the head's shape bent onto the dominant: it starts on the flat ninth

motifs.name: lift1
motifs.note: the seventh of the first chord held, falling to the third of the next, then up through its sixth

motifs.name: lift2
motifs.note: higher; the climb is in thirds now

motifs.name: lift3
motifs.note: under the first tune's top note, then up the dominant to its flat ninth

motifs.name: lift4
motifs.note: after three climbs, a fall: home

motifs.name: rise
motifs.note: the seventh of the first chord held, falling to the third of the next, then up through its sixth

motifs.name: thud
motifs.note: the sub under the cycle: long, a hole where the snare is, the fifth on the way out

motifs.name: prowl
motifs.note: the sub under the dive: home and the semitone above it

ops.note: the loop caught and stuttered, the way a sampler would
